name: Jateen Narsai
description: Meet Solvero founder Jateen Narsai: business and systems analysis, solution design and delivery, informed by almost two decades in financial services.
biography: Jateen is the founder of Solvero, with almost two decades of financial services experience across business and systems analysis, solution design and software delivery. He works through complex problems, connects business and technical teams, and carries agreed work from requirements through testing and handover.
